name: Celestine Orrery Pinion
description: A polished celestial gear keyed to stellar alignments.
specialEffects: Used in observatory staves, orbital foci, and star-synced housings.

steps: Refine raw stock for Celestine Orrery Pinion under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Celestine Refinery protocol before storage.
